scope: Bounded finite chunk conservation and link-ready publication; not a native reachability or C memory-model proof.

cases.scope: One active producer retains eligible completed chunks in existing intrusive chunk-link words; only two local endpoints are needed regardless of continuation length. A finished-link prefix and private/public/scanned sets abstract that representation. Publish only after all links are finished, before producer idle. No queue lock spans copying or scanning. Physical link layout, local-scan exclusion, allocation failure and C ordering remain source-refinement obligations.
